chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
That Abū Ṭalḥah al-Anṣārī made the laḥd grave-niche for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.أَبُو طَلْحَةَ: Abū Ṭalḥah, the Anṣārī companion mentioned in the report
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the transmitter in the matn
key_terms.رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.لَحَدَ: he made the side-niche in the grave
key_terms.ٱلْأَنْصَارِيُّ: the one belonging to the Anṣār, the Helpers of Madinah

ai.seo_question: Who prepared the laḥd for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Ṭalḥah al-Anṣārī prepared the laḥd grave-niche for the burial of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It is a brief historical report connected to funerary practice and the events surrounding the Prophet’s burial.
